text:
alice: FYI spotted a weird bump in the cost dashboard for /summarize around 05:12 UTC. token burn doubled for a few minutes.
ben: saw that too. looks correlated with a quota rollover event and sticky routing landing more traffic on a slab with prefetch credits.
carla: do we have an easy way to map those slab allocations to the per-model unit-econ panel? current panels aggregate too much.
dave: the lineage is messy — when the quota gate flips we demux by tenant but keep slab affinity for 30s so prefetch credits could be applied twice in the billing window.
erin: is this the token-gated quota change from last week's rollout? @infra-bot did the canary toggle complete?
infra-bot: deploy:quota-gating v2 -> canary complete (10 hosts). Metric alert: quota-gating.v2.error_rate = 0.2% (no action).
alice: yeah deployed last Wed. I think the issue is the interaction between token gating and the sampling we use for cost telemetry (sample_rate=0.01). if a sticky route funnels heavy short-lived bursts into a single slab, sampling overweights that slab.
ben: suggestion: expose a per-slab and per-route normalized token-rate in the UI (tokens/sec normalized by slab-size) plus a sparklines view with sample confidence intervals.
carla: +1. also want a drilldown that shows cache-savings attribution split across routes when slab prefetch is shared. right now the dashboard awards the entire prefetch credit to the tenant that triggered the slab, which penalizes co-tenants.
dave: naive fix: amortize prefetch credits by active-connection-time within slab window. Implementation: for each slab_id in window, compute credit_per_tenant = total_prefetch_credit * (active_tokens_tenant / total_active_tokens).
erin: that math is fine but we need to consider sticky routing's tail: tenant A opens 1 big op, tenant B hits cached keys later — do we charge B some of A's prefetch? product might argue yes for fairness.
alice: product note: customers asked to see "net unit cost" per model version, not per-connection. they prefer conservative attribution (credit to originator) for auditability. but internal chargeback wants fair split.
ben: ops concern: we must avoid adding an O(N) join on telemetry ingestion. we need a streaming-friendly approximation. one option: maintain a per-slab reservoir sample of tenant token-weights and emit periodic aggregates.
carla: sample-based amortization will be noisy. can we show a "confidence" band in the dashboard, i.e., Estimated cache savings: $X (±$Y, 95% CI)?
dave: yep, we already compute stddev on sample windows for latency; reuse same pipeline. need schema change: slab_event should include tenant_id and token_count. lightweight.
erin: rollout plan: feature-flag the amortized attribution, show in a beta toggle in console under Cost -> Experimental. start with 1% of customers and a small cohort of internal tenants.
alice: telemetry alerts to add: if per-route net unit cost deviates >20% from baseline after attribution change, trigger auto-explain job (runs evals on sample prompts).
ben: quick SQL sketch for debug (for analytics team):
```sql
SELECT slab_id, tenant_id, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM slab_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '{{window_start}}' AND '{{window_end}}'
GROUP BY slab_id, tenant_id
ORDER BY slab_id, tokens DESC
```
carla: nice. also add slab_prefetch_credit table join to compute amortized_credit.
dave: action items: 1) infra: add tenant_id to slab_event (low perf risk) 2) eng-platform: prototyping sample-reservoir flow 3) console: add beta toggle + ci for confidence bands 4) product: define default attribution policy and messaging.
erin: I'll own rollout coordination and the canary gating. plan to wave rollout over 2 weeks.
alice: ok cool. follow-ups: ben will prototype dashboard mockups, carla will run a replay on last month's data to estimate variance, dave will write an RFC for ingestion schema change.
ben: mockups by EOD Friday. carla: replay job queued. dave: RFC draft up by Monday.
carla: note — if we find big variance we should consider exposing per-tenant adjustment knobs (e.g., conservative vs. fair) in billing exports.
alice: thanks all. i'll drop a short note in product channel once we have mockups. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: job:replay slab_events -> queued (job_id=zx-9931).
